target_customer: Small restaurants and cafes in Indonesia
problem: Owners abandon accounting software within months and lack readable financial statements; Delegasi turned POS, delivery data and receipts into statements and analysis.

founders.name: Okky Pratama
founders.background_notes: Senior VP of Business and Operations at Modal Rakyat per YC page.

founders.name: Ans Syuhada
founders.background_notes: Product development and data-intensive systems experience per YC page; also called Anshorimuslim. The founders have known each other over twelve years.

competitors.name: BukuWarung
competitors.what: Indonesian bookkeeping and payments app for micro merchants, a YC S20 company
competitors.traction_then: More than 1.2 million merchants across 750 locations as of September 2020
competitors.funding_then: Over eight-figure USD raised, including Soma Capital after YC

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting POS, delivery platform and bank data and producing correct statements needs many integrations and accounting rules, standard but laborious.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations create some stickiness, but established apps such as Jurnal, Accurate and BukuWarung already served small business.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented in the sources read.

market_need_then: The YC page states founders saw owners abandon many accounting products within months; no independent demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: delegasi.co is now parked and the page says the domain may be for sale

identity.voice_and_tone: Positioned as the first virtual financial manager

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found, and the name search returned unrelated Indonesian rebrands.

outcome_analysis: Delegasi, from the Summer 2022 batch, raised a seed from YC and BEENEXT, and its domain is now parked while YC lists it inactive. No shutdown announcement or founder statement was found, so the cause is not public.
notes: The DailySocial article returned HTTP 503 when fetched, so the seed and BEENEXT are known from its search snippet only; the US$500K amount comes from one aggregator (Extruct) and is unverified, and the date is only the year. A parked domain suggests operations ended but no source states it, so exit is unknown. The BukuWarung source predates the batch by about two years and is the only dated competitor.
